title: Answer: consciousness is the global availability of information through the workspace

statements.text: In the global workspace theory, a piece of information becomes conscious when top-down attention amplifies the neural population that represents it into a brain-scale state of coherent activity. Its content is then available at once to many processes, such as categorization, long-term memory, evaluation and intentional action. This global availability of information through the workspace is what is experienced as a conscious state.
statements.scope: the 2001 workspace framework of Dehaene and Naccache

sources.quote: into a brain-scale state of coherent activity that involves many neurons distributed throughout the brain.
We postulate that this global availability of information through the workspace is what we subjectively experience as a conscious state.
